schema: ER12 bounded critic source map v1
access_observation_note: Critic access_utc values are UTC times captured immediately after the relevant local-read or browser/web source batch returned. Mutable documentation is not frozen; pin versions before a future pilot. Local case inputs are identified by path and SHA-256. No topic database/API or municipal portal search was run.

sources.title: Missing local studies in a small evidence collection — released brief
sources.version_or_commit: Frozen input; SHA-256 f8e7a04dcbb7e639c873f1291872f13a7d66d3f191247f79a263283fdad2aedf
sources.locator: Requirements lines 13-31; especially separate discovery coverage/screening workload/identity and distinguish executed from proposed work.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only review of the released brief and a targeted line search; no edits.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: No search export or known complete reference set; scope and later screening time remain undecided; the task is a synthetic planning proposal, not an effectiveness conclusion.
sources.applicability: Authoritative source for the stage's original obligations, boundaries, and unresolved decisions.

sources.title: Missing local studies — exact revealed design plan
sources.version_or_commit: Released plan SHA-256 05b07646a51d90cfe102deabf5b52dab894ce633469a62455d3f70a351abe374; matches frozen plan and plan-reveal.json.
sources.locator: Research question/open decisions lines 53-55; proposed validation and no-ground-truth constraint lines 71; full-session/implementation-history clause lines 77.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only review of the exact revealed plan and targeted line search; no edits.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The union of found records is not complete ground truth; useful additions are independently identified and scope/time are open.
sources.applicability: Authoritative extra design clauses to adjudicate the draft beyond the original brief.

sources.title: Investigator executed search and desk-check log
sources.locator: Public-web queries actually executed; opened primary sources; not-executed section.
sources.observed_operation: Reopened the complete carried log read-only and inspected its executed-query, opened-source, and not-executed sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The browser tool did not expose per-query timestamps; the log says no topic database/API query, municipal portal search, title-level retrieval, screening, or identity adjudication was performed.
sources.applicability: Supports the distinction between investigator desk research actually executed and the later pilot actions proposed.

sources.title: PRISMA-S: an extension to the PRISMA Statement for Reporting Literature Searches in Systematic Reviews
sources.version_or_commit: Final journal article, Systematic Reviews 10, 39 (2021); publisher version.
sources.locator: Abstract and introduction lines 50-63; item 5 citation searching lines 233-235; item 11 prior work lines 356-364.
sources.observed_operation: Opened primary publisher article; checked its stated purpose and selected reporting items.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The extension is specifically for reporting literature searches in systematic reviews and related review types; it is a reporting checklist, not a search algorithm or proof of completeness.
sources.applicability: Adaptable disclosure checklist for the pilot's database, portal, citation, prior-strategy, and deduplication logs; label it as adapted guidance.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook, Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies
sources.version_or_commit: Cochrane Handbook version 6.5.1; chapter last updated March 2025 per page citation.
sources.locator: Sections 4.2.3, 4.3.4/5, and especially 4.4.11 lines 495-501 on stopping rules, scarce evidence, adequacy checks, and citation/reference checks.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official chapter and inspected the report/study distinction and full stopping-rule passage.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Cochrane conduct guidance for intervention systematic reviews; it says stop-rule approaches have little formal evaluation and scarce topics call for caution.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's cautious route-conditional adequacy checks and explicit stop-rule treatment, with scope stated.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook Technical Supplement to Chapter 4
sources.version_or_commit: Handbook version 6.5; supplement last updated September 2024 per carried source map.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 13-15 on grey-literature scope/feasibility; complete locator inherited from investigator source-map.json.
sources.observed_operation: Official PDF open returned title, PDF type, and 121-page metadata; body excerpt was not independently extracted in this critic stage.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Not relied on for any SCW verdict; full locator and original observation metadata remain in the investigator source map.
sources.applicability: Carried source ID preserved without reusing it for another source.

sources.title: Urban Heat Island Mitigation Strategies: 2021 Update
sources.version_or_commit: Institut national de santé publique du Québec, November 2021 report; Appendix 1, printed pp. 126-128 / PDF pp. 139-141.
sources.locator: Appendix 1 lines 4554-4575 for scope, database/date/language/query details and scientific-stream counts; lines 4605-4623 for selected items and grey-source searches/stopping.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary PDF and inspected surrounding headings, scientific-search counts, gray-literature scope, and stop condition.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The source says the work targeted measures applicable in Québec; the 4,487/985 counts are in the scientific-literature subsection; the grey passage names engines/sites and a relevance-based stop, but not portal-specific yields or a numerical/page cap.
sources.applicability: Close urban-heat implementation comparator; use its disclosure pattern, not its eligibility, geography, term set, or stop practice as a universal default.

sources.title: OpenAlex API Search — Querying
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable help page; current page says last updated October 3, 2026.
sources.locator: What gets searched; relevance score; semantic search sections. Critic checked the full page text.
sources.observed_operation: Opened in collaborative preview and read page text; checked work search fields, score components, and semantic-search behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Works search lists title, abstract, fulltext, and keywords; default relevance score includes text similarity, a capped citation contribution, and a keyword bonus. The page does not specify that the search index coverage equals downloadable full-text coverage.
sources.applicability: Candidate scholarly search route; freeze exact requests, paging, returned fields, ranking/sort and current behavior; not a municipal-report denominator.

sources.title: Crossref REST API documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable API documentation; page is described in the carried map as last updated 2020-04-08; live behavior must be rechecked.
sources.locator: REST API overview, lines 112-119.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Crossref documentation and inspected metadata source and public REST API description.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The API exposes scholarly metadata deposited by Crossref members and trusted sources; records absent from those deposits are not retrieved through it.
sources.applicability: Supplemental DOI/report-metadata and linking route, not complete municipal report coverage.

sources.title: Crossref REST API filters
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable filter reference; carried source map records page last updated October 16, 2025.
sources.locator: Works filters lines 143-150; date/approved-date conditions lines 155-180; type/type-name filters lines 256-265.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official filter reference and checked relevant heading, type filter, and approved-date constraints.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The type filter matches metadata records whose type equals a registered type value; approved-date filters are only documented for dissertation, standard, and report types. Unregistered/miscoded reports are not made visible by the filter.
sources.applicability: Can test Crossref-deposited report-like records and metadata gaps; direct city portal/repository searches remain separate.

sources.title: Zotero Duplicate Detection
sources.version_or_commit: Mutable main branch; GitHub page displayed main/history but no latest commit SHA; not revision-pinned.
sources.locator: Finding Duplicates lines 193-201; Merging Duplicates lines 202-205.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current official Zotero documentation and inspected matcher fields, false-positive limitation, library boundary, and merge guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Candidate detection uses title/DOI/ISBN and conditions on year/creator; detection only works within one library, does not cross group libraries, and the docs say false-positive matches cannot currently be marked as non-duplicates.
sources.applicability: Candidate generation only; preserve source records and adjudicate identity/version links reversibly.

sources.title: ASReview LAB Progress and Results
sources.version_or_commit: Stable docs labeled ASReview LAB 3.0.8.
sources.locator: Stop screening lines 58-62; export fields lines 85-115.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current stable documentation and checked threshold default, stop interaction, threshold guidance, and export behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Threshold is unset by default; after a user-set threshold is reached, the user is asked whether to stop; ideal threshold is still researched. Export carries labels and missing labels for records not screened.
sources.applicability: Workload aid on the retrieved set, not a discovery route or completeness measure.

sources.title: ASReview release history
sources.version_or_commit: Investigator source-map observation: v3.0.5 516290b; v3.0.6 f1d388e; v3.0.7 05b68eb; v3.0.8 d3e863c; year not shown in observed release-history rows.
sources.locator: Original locator and access time preserved from investigator source-map.json; individual tag pages were reopened separately as S014-S017.
sources.observed_operation: Carried source identity from investigator map; not independently reopened at this broad URL in the critic stage.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes are maintainer statements about particular fixes; they do not prove other failure modes are absent.
sources.applicability: Source ID preserved; critic's release-history review relies on direct release-tag records S014-S017.

sources.title: OpenAlex Works attributes
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable page; last updated October 7, 2026.
sources.locator: has_content, has_fulltext, and content_urls fields lines 198-206.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official attributes page and checked per-work full-text availability indicators.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The page defines per-work downloadable-content flags and says more than 50 million works have PDF content; it does not state that search-index coverage exactly equals downloadable content coverage.
sources.applicability: Adds the per-work content condition to S005; do not conflate downloadable text with exact search-index coverage.

sources.title: OpenAlex Fulltext
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable product documentation; last updated September 18, 2026.
sources.locator: Overview and content availability lines 34-42; content filter lines 59-70.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Fulltext product page and checked available corpus, per-work indicator, access and licensing conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: OpenAlex reports cached full text for 50 million-plus open-access works; per-work availability is exposed through has_content/content_urls, and content downloads require an API key and are metered. Copyright remains with the original source.
sources.applicability: Shows that downloadable full-text availability is not universal; it does not by itself define fulltext.search index completeness.

sources.title: OpenAlex Open access — Works
sources.version_or_commit: Official mutable data-reference page; last updated August 11, 2026.
sources.locator: Corpus scale and OA definition lines 41-52; status table lines 55-63.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official OpenAlex data-reference page and checked work count and full-text access conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Page reports roughly 322 million works and about 121 million OA works; OA has a specific free-to-read definition and is not the same as the full-text search index.
sources.applicability: Useful context for why full-text availability cannot be assumed for every work; do not join the OA count to search-index coverage without a stated relation.
